changes: Updated parts.py to preserve empty CSV columns and use exact ID equality. Added regression tests for empty descriptions, prefix collisions, absent exact matches, quoted commas, and case/whitespace sensitivity.
diagnosis: The importer discarded empty cells, turning `P7,,4` into two columns. The lookup used `startswith`, allowing `P70` to match `P7`.
verification: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passed all 8 tests. Python syntax compilation also passed.
